prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin across all kinds of changes, as no category has at least 2 tests yet.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to actual noise-corrected results.
No clear effect was seen for sign_in, reorder changes.
Adding a new_screen to finish controls reduced completion, but evidence for this kind of change is still thin.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- finish, new_screen: -5.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Screen Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split layout to directly compare pre-made pets against custom generation options. (why: Adoption has a low conversion rate of 60.9% and high median duration of 89s, showing strong selection friction.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Customization Guided Wizard: Transform photo upload into a step-by-step guided photo verification flow with step counters and visual helper tips. (why: Adoption takes over 1000s on average and support logged 3 custom pet rendering bug tickets.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Flow Order Adjustment: Reorder the sign-in step to explicitly follow initial path selection while preserving all required onboarding screens. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% and users report confusion regarding account state and missing pets.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Generation Status & Tips: Display explicit status updates, time estimates, and desktop tray launcher hints during pet asset generation. (why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s (mean 2336s) and support received 3 emails about pets missing on desktop.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery & Sync Hint: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that signing in restores existing pets and saved data. (why: The top support theme with 8 complaints is pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [finish, notification] Pet Ready System Tray Notification: Enable desktop readiness notifications and taskbar tips on the home intro screen. (why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% with an mean duration of 5815s due to lost desktop pet windows.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Path Selection Two-Column Layout: Update choose_path layout to a two-column card view to clearly delineate quick setup vs custom pet creation. (why: Choose path takes an average of 514s despite 76.2% conversion, showing hesitation during path selection.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Onboarding Story Desktop Value Proposition: Revise story screen copy to explain desktop widget capabilities and control options upfront. (why: Users experience confusion after onboarding regarding pet behavior, hiding, and controls.)

scores.note: High drop-off on adoption screen, but redesign is high effort and evidence relies only on funnel metrics.
Strong evidence from both long duration and 3 support tickets, though wizard flow requires new UI screens.
Reordering sign_in showed no effect (-0.1%) in prior testing, giving zero confidence.
Clear bottleneck during generation step backed by 3 support emails and long wait times.
Top support issue (8 complaints) addressed with low-cost copy hint on sign-in screen.
Finish step drops 35.2% of users with extreme mean duration; system tray tips address lost windows.
Choose path already converts relatively well at 76.2%; high duration suggests hesitation but evidence is thin.
Low cost copy change to clarify controls upfront, targeting downstream post-onboarding confusion.
